title: Roth IRA Contribution Limit 2024 - Tax-Free Growth Guide
excerpt: Maximize your retirement savings with Roth IRA. Learn 2024 contribution limits and benefits of tax-free retirement growth.
content:
Roth IRAs offer tax-free growth and tax-free withdrawals in retirement, making them one of the most powerful retirement savings vehicles.

## 2024 Roth IRA Contribution Limits

- Under 50: $7,000
- 50 and older: $8,000

## Income Limits for Roth IRA

Roth IRA contributions have income limits:
- Single: Modified AGI < $161,000 (full), $161,000-$191,000 (phase-out)
- Married: Modified AGI < $240,000 (full), $240,000-$259,000 (phase-out)

## Roth IRA Benefits

1. Tax-free growth
2. Tax-free withdrawals in retirement
3. No required minimum distributions
4. Can withdraw contributions anytime

## Backdoor Roth IRA

If you exceed income limits, you can do a "backdoor Roth IRA" by contributing to a traditional IRA and converting to Roth.
